title: Beyond the Prompt: Recovering Hidden Concepts in Text-to-Image Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.27473v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Text-to-image models can generate visual concepts that their prompts never mention, and recent work shows that such associations can be implanted so that ordinary prompts trigger them. Auditing this behavior requires recovering the description that a prompt omits. Existing prompt optimizers are not well suited to this task. Gradient-based methods require backward access to the scoring encoder. Discrete evolutionary search treats semantically unrelated tokens as equally close. Language-model-guided search requires one inference call per candidate, which limits exploration. This paper presents EmbGA, an embedding-space genetic algorithm that recovers concepts present in a set of images but absent from the prompt that generated them. EmbGA keeps the population structure of genetic search but applies its operators in the token embedding space. Crossover interpolates between parent embeddings, and mutation moves an embedding toward a random

translated_title: 超越提示词：恢复文本到图像模型中的隐藏概念
translated_abstract: 文本到图像模型能够生成其提示词中从未提及的视觉概念，近期研究表明，这种关联可以被人为植入，使得普通提示词也能触发这些概念。审计这种行为需要恢复提示词所省略的描述内容，但现有的提示词优化器并不适合这项任务：基于梯度的方法需要对评分编码器的反向访问；离散进化搜索将语义不相关的词元视为同样接近；语言模型引导的搜索则需要为每个候选方案进行一次推理调用，这限制了探索范围。本文提出了EmbGA，一种嵌入空间遗传算法，用于恢复一组图像中存在但生成这些图像的提示词中缺失的概念。EmbGA保留了遗传搜索的种群结构，但将其算子应用于词元嵌入空间中：交叉操作在父代嵌入之间进行插值，变异操作则将一个嵌入向随机的（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出EmbGA，一种在词元嵌入空间中运行的遗传算法，能够恢复文本到图像模型生成的图像中存在但提示词未提及的隐藏概念，为审计被植入的触发关联提供了有效工具。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces EmbGA, an embedding-space genetic algorithm that recovers concepts present in text-to-image model outputs but absent from their prompts, enabling auditing of implanted trigger associations.
